description: Brew is an AI-native email service provider that stores contacts, manages sending infrastructure and domain authentication, and uses AI to generate on-brand emails, automations, and audience segments. It also provides analytics, domain management, and automation tooling for marketing and transactional email workflows.
summary: brew.new exposes three developer integration surfaces: a REST Public API v1, a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server, and a standalone `brew-cli`; the API and CLI use Brew API keys, while MCP supports either self-onboarding OAuth 2.1 with DCR+PKCE or a Brew API key.
